anti_root.description: Android only: enable friTap's anti-root-detection hooks (-ar/--anti_root). Changes app behaviour; use only on authorized targets.

args.description: Arguments for a spawned executable (spawn=true only).

capture.description: keys: + keylog; plaintext: .tap only; full: + keylog + pcap.

device.description: 'local' (default), 'usb' (first USB device) or a Frida device id.

duration_s.description: The capture stops cleanly after this many seconds.

follow_exec.description: Spawn mode: follow the target across exec().

host.description: Remote frida-server as ip:port (wins over device).

force_scan.description: Modules to force the BoringSSL pattern scan on (regex with 're:').

library_scan.description: Pre-scan for renamed/statically linked TLS libraries.

no_loader_hook.description: Android: skip the android_dlopen_ext loader hook.

offsets.description: Hook offsets JSON file or inline JSON string.

pairip_safe.description: Android: minimal scan-free hooks for PairIP-protected apps.

patterns.description: Byte-pattern JSON file (path inside the sandbox root; no inline JSON).

protocols.description: Protocols to hook; omit for automatic detection.

spawn.description: Spawn the target (true) or attach to a running process.

target.description: App identifier, process name, pid or executable path.
